speaker: Doctor
text:
Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To begin our evaluation of your feeding difficulties and abdominal distension, can you tell me when these symptoms started and how much weight your baby has gained since birth?

REQUEST TEST: Birth_history, Growth_chart

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for that information; normal growth so far is reassuring. Given the abdominal distension, have you noticed any vomiting, specifically if it is projectile or contains green bile, and has your baby passed stool and gas normally?

REQUEST TEST: Stool_frequency, Vomiting_characteristics
REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_ultrasound

speaker: Doctor
text:
With normal bowel habits and no projectile vomiting, I need to check for signs of constipation or an anal abnormality. Can you describe the stool consistency and tell me if you have noticed any "currant jelly" stools or blood?

REQUEST TEST: Stool_consistency, Anus_inspection
REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_X-Ray

speaker: Doctor
text: Normal stool consistency and no blood are reassuring, but the abdominal distension warrants further imaging. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_X-Ray to check for obstruction or air-fluid levels. If the X-ray is normal, we will proceed with a targeted ultrasound to rule out rare causes like meconium ileus or intestinal atresia. REQUEST TEST: Abdominal_ultrasound (if not already obtained in the previous turn).
